ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M1-2,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 18-D in the area bound by:

       East 73rd Street; the west right-of-way line of the Illinois Central Railroad; East 73 rd
       Street; and South Woodlawn Avenue;

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                              Alderman, 5th Ward




Common Address:
7343 S. Woodlawn Avenue
